title: 平均高度
problem_statement_md:
一个篮球队的身高存储在一个**字典**中。
请计算并输出该队的**平均**高度。

使用一个**for**循环来遍历字典并计算出平均高度。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Average Height[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The heights of a basketball team are stored in a [b]map[/b].
You need to calculate and output the [b]average[/b] height of the team.

Use a [b]for[/b] loop to iterate over the map and calculate the average height.
[note]To find the average, you need to calculate the sum of all the heights and divide it by the number of players.[/note]
hint_md: 为了找到平均数，需要计算所有身高的总和并除以球员的数量。
